secondaryControlEvidence.use: corroborates the existence and order of a separate `Calentura tener` entry; BUE1890 orthography and Cahita forms are not transferred into ALC1737

resolution.rationale: L-019 begins at the canonical left-column margin as an independent candidate. L-018 already contains the first `Calentura` article and an OCR fragment `tener*`; L-019 begins with a second `Calentura` and damaged form material, while both the recovered ALC1737 OCR sequence and BUE1890 preserve the ordered pair `Calentura` / `Calentura tener` before `Caliente`. The most conservative structural interpretation is therefore a real second article boundary whose complete guide is fragmented by OCR grouping across L-018/L-019.

epistemicGuards: This resolution changes only candidate-level structure; it does not create a new lexical article object.
No uncertain ALC1737 Cahita form is normalized or promoted.
BUE1890 is a secondary sequence control and never silently substitutes for the 1737 witness.
The selected article layer remains non-exhaustive and the visible-start census remains non-exhaustive.
No precision, recall or F1 metric is claimed.

provenance.method: Convergent structural reconciliation from materialized canonical geometry/OCR, recovered same-witness OCR sequence, and explicit BUE1890 secondary sequence control; conservative non-promotion rule applied.
